messages:
rachel: Heads-up: multiple customer reports of 504s hitting eu-west embeddings after the latest quant merge. Dashboard shows spikes starting ~11:12 UTC. Can we expedite a hotfix? @diego @emily
ops-bot: alert: embeddings-service (eu-west1) 504 rate 3.4% over 5m, route=/v1/embeddings, recent deploy tag=quant-merge-2026
diego: I have a tiny patch hotfix/quant-null-safeguard that adds defensive checks when KV chunks are empty. Staged smoke passed (embed create + query).
emily: oncall grants expedited deploy if we keep canary <= 5% and define rollback triggers: abort if 504 >1% sustained for 6m or error-growth >2x.
rachel: approving from product. Also request temporary route pin for eu-west to the hotfix while we validate. Who will run it?
diego: I'll run it: /deploy hotfix hotfix/quant-null-safeguard --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --monitor=6m --pin-route=eu-west=temp-hotfix
deploy-bot: command received: /deploy hotfix hotfix/quant-null-safeguard --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --monitor=6m --pin-route=eu-west=temp-hotfix
deploy-bot: launching 5% canary in eu-west1; monitor window 6m. Notifying ops and release.
ops-bot: 3m into canary: 504 on canary hosts 0.25% (baseline 0.28%). traces show the safeguard exercised. No infra alerts.
emily: expand to 30% for another 6m. If stable, promote and keep pin for 1h.
diego: scaling: /deploy scale hotfix hotfix/quant-null-safeguard --to=30% --monitor=6m
deploy-bot: scaling canary to 30% in eu-west1
ops-bot: 4m into 30% window: 504 0.27%, p95 latency stable. No downstream failures.
deploy-bot: canary windows passed. promoting to 100% in eu-west1. route pin applied: eu-west -> hotfix/quant-null-safeguard (temporary)
ops-bot: post-promote checks (5m): 504 down to 0.06%, p95 latency back to baseline. No regression flags.
rachel: closing expedited approval. Diego please post a short release note with commit hash and the rollback command, and leave runbook updated.
diego: posting release note: "hotfix/quant-null-safeguard (commit 7f3b2a1) - defensive KV guard; rollforward OK. Revert: /deploy rollback 7f3b2a1 --env=eu-west1"
support: drafting customer blurb and standing by to notify if anything changes.
